description: Append-oriented event history for state transitions, approvals and consequential project activity.

events.summary: Projects House skeleton built and live on GitHub Pages: seven pages, five empty JSON registries, manuscript-approval rule posted on the Foyer and in policies.json.
Revised comprehensive inventory adopted as the governing inventory, superseding Muse's first walk of the same evening.

Public visibility resolved: the repository and Pages stay public. Core rule adopted: TRP tracks the work and does not warehouse sensitive material; manuscripts, correspondence, contracts, and financial records stay in protected storage, and TRP holds pointers and operational metadata only. remprojects.org stays unpointed.
Seven-work seed for the canonical works registry approved and committed to data/works.json.
Webworks registry approved and committed to data/webworks.json: eight properties, the complete known set.

Publishing Ledger approved and committed to data/submissions.json: 26 records. Note: the commit message reads '25 records' in error (Muse's count, caught on verification); the file holds 26 records and its content is exactly as approved. This event is the correction of record.

Backfill event, appended 2026-11-16 at Robert's ruling: two works records were added to data/works.json on 2026-11-15 beyond the approved seven-work seed: Remembering You're Extraordinary (original) and Remembering You're Extraordinary, RYE 2.0, both on Robert's confirmations of that day. No event recorded them at the time; this backfill completes the history. Robert confirmed on 2026-11-16 that both records are his as they stand.

Robert ruled: there is only one book, Remembering You're Extraordinary, and RYE 2.0 is version 2 of it, not a second work. The two works records were folded into one record in data/works.json, with version 2 noted on it as in active development in Santa's Workshop. The earlier two-record state remains in this history and in the 2026-11-15 backfill event.
